topic: New API endpoint for frequency clustering
summary_markdown:
A new endpoint, `/frequency_clust`, was introduced. This endpoint accepts data structured with `facility_num`, `session_number_predicted`, `latitude`, and `longitude` for multiple sessions across different days and cities (e.g., Rio de Janeiro or São Paulo).

The functionality requested by someone regarding a specific formula for Provantage, using the parameter `city="São Paulo"`, can only be enabled on the staging environment initially.
decisions: The new `/frequency_clust` endpoint requires deployment to the stage environment first.
action_items: Someone will follow up regarding the deployment status of the API endpoint.
